semantics.restrictionNone: Pass the class/role restriction check; other placement/dependency/ownership checks still apply.
semantics.restrictionRole: Compare RoleRestriction with the selected character role; no packaged chip explicitly serializes this restriction in the inspected catalog.
semantics.restrictionKit: Pass when selected class is KitRestriction or its subclass, OR matches any AlternativeKitsAllowed class or its subclass.
semantics.originKit: Not read by IsKitAllowed; preserve as origin/unlock metadata, not an equip restriction.
semantics.modifierTagAutoPopulation: When Type is Modifier and bDoNotAutoPopulateCompatibilityTags is false, append each Modifiers[].ModifierTag.TagName into Tags.
semantics.tagCompatibility: Any core ModifierCompatability tag must equal a modifier effective Tag or one of that Tag's dot-separated ancestors.
semantics.adjacency: Orthogonal occupied-cell perimeter neighbors; diagonal-only contact does not connect.
semantics.groups: An adjacent chip identifies a connected group; incoming modifier is tested against that group's Core. Compatible modifier chains can therefore reach the core indirectly.
semantics.abilityOverrideExclusion: If incoming modifier has a non-null GrantedAbilityOverride, reject groups already containing any chip with non-null GrantedAbilityOverride.
semantics.coreVsModifier: Core has Type=0 and forms its own group; Modifier has Type=1 and requires a compatible group.

source.restrictionDefault: No constructor override at native byte0x478; UObject pre-constructor zero initialization gives enum None=0.

limitations: This is an audited static translation for this exact executable, not a runtime dump or full decompiler.
Full current acquisition/catalog membership and role-restriction character values are not recovered here.
Shape replacement and multi-group merge edge cases remain additional native research scope; graph reachability captures the observed compatible modifier-chain behavior.
